name: Igniters (piezo, spark and hot surface)
summary: Parts that light gas or fuel: piezo clickers, electronic spark modules and glowing hot-surface igniters.
uses: Lighting stoves, grills and heaters without matches
Fire starting with a spare grill clicker
Repairing a gas appliance that won’t light
identify: Piezo igniters are push-button or click units with one wire to a spark tip, in grills, gas lighters and camp stoves. Spark modules are small boxes that tick fast, in gas cookers, water heaters and patio heaters. Hot-surface igniters are brittle grey or black ceramic bars in furnaces and gas dryers; they run on mains and glow hot enough to burn.
test: Click a piezo or power a spark module near grounded metal: a blue spark should jump 3–5 mm. A hot-surface igniter should show continuity on a meter and glow orange within seconds on its rated voltage.

decay.note: Piezos last; hot-surface igniters crack if dropped or touched.
